description.en: Jim Guard Custom (equipped with E-2 beam spray gun), which is connected to the "Gym" variation lineage, is commercialized with HGKit!

description.en: Parts including the chest and school bag have been recreated with new modeling, and the characteristic E-2 beam spray gun is included.

description.en: ● Comes with a variety of optional parts such as E-2 beam spray gun and open hand parts.

description.en: Two newly designed E-2 beam spray guns are included. Furthermore, open hand parts for left and right hands are included to expand the range of poses.
